jobs.description:
A SolarGrid atua no mercado de energia renovável, com soluções voltadas à Geração Distribuída (GD) e à redução de custos com energia para empresas.

Estamos ampliando nossa rede de relacionamento comercial e buscamos parceiros comerciais independentesinteressados em identificar e desenvolver oportunidades de novos negócios junto a empresas consumidoras de energia.

Sobre a parceria

Esta oportunidade refere-se a uma parceria comercial independente e não a uma vaga de emprego.

Buscamos profissionais ou empresas que desejem atuar de forma autônoma e independente, utilizando sua rede de relacionamentos, experiência comercial e capacidade de prospecção para conectar potenciais clientes à SolarGrid.

A remuneração será exclusivamente vinculada ao sucesso dos negócios efetivamente convertidos, conforme as condições comerciais estabelecidas para a parceria.

O parceiro terá liberdade para organizar sua própria atuação comercial, sem exclusividade, jornada predeterminada ou subordinação hierárquica.

É uma oportunidade especialmente interessante para profissionais que já possuem relacionamento com empresas e decisores e desejam transformar esse networking em uma fonte adicional de receita.

A SolarGrid dará suporte ao parceiro com informações comerciais, materiais de apresentação e apoio técnico e comercial necessário para o desenvolvimento das oportunidades.

Mais do que um vendedor tradicional, buscamos pessoas que consigam abrir portas.

Profissionais que conheçam empresários e decisores, tenham credibilidade junto à sua rede de relacionamentos e consigam identificar empresas para as quais uma solução de redução de custos com energia possa gerar valor econômico relevante.

O objetivo é construir uma rede qualificada de parceiros comerciais independentes da SolarGrid, capaz de gerar oportunidades de negócio de forma descentralizada, escalável e baseada em resultado.O parceiro poderá:

  • Identificar empresas com potencial de contratação das soluções oferecidas pela SolarGrid;
  • Utilizar sua rede de contatos e relacionamento profissional para gerar novas oportunidades comerciais;
  • Prospectar potenciais clientes por meio de relacionamento próprio, telefone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, e-mail, eventos ou outros canais;
  • Identificar e acessar decisores e influenciadores dentro das empresas;
  • Realizar a abordagem inicial e identificar o interesse e o potencial do cliente;
  • Apresentar a oportunidade e conectar o potencial cliente à equipe comercial da SolarGrid;
  • Quando fizer sentido, participar de reuniões e apoiar o desenvolvimento da oportunidade comercial;
  • Auxiliar na construção do relacionamento com o cliente durante o processo de negociação;
  • Gerar novas oportunidades de negócio de forma recorrente.
Procuramos pessoas com:

  • Experiência ou forte relacionamento no mercado B2B;
  • Capacidade de acessar empreendedores (pequeno e médio porte), empresários, executivos, diretores, gestores financeiros, gestores de facilities, responsáveis por energia ou outros tomadores de decisão;
  • Perfil empreendedor, comercial e orientado a resultados;
  • Facilidade para desenvolver relacionamentos e identificar oportunidades de negócio;
  • Credibilidade e boa capacidade de interlocução com empresas;
  • Autonomia para desenvolver sua própria estratégia de geração de negócios.
  • Não é necessário que a pessoa esteja buscando uma nova posição profissional.
  • Pelo contrário: podem ser excelentes parceiros profissionais que já atuem como empresários, consultores, representantes comerciais, assessores, executivos independentes ou prestadores de serviços e que possuam relacionamento com potenciais clientes da SolarGrid.

Podem ter excelente aderência à parceria:

  • Consultores empresariais;
  • Consultores de energia;
  • Representantes comerciais independentes;
  • Profissionais de desenvolvimento de negócios;
  • Consultores financeiros;
  • Contadores e empresas de contabilidade;
  • Consultores tributários;
  • Corretores e consultores imobiliários com atuação empresarial;
  • Empresas de facilities e serviços corporativos;
  • Integradores e profissionais ligados ao setor de energia;
  • Profissionais dos setores de infraestrutura, indústria, logística, varejo, agronegócio e serviços;
  • Ex-executivos com amplo relacionamento empresarial;
  • Empresários e profissionais com forte networking regional;
  • Pessoas que já atuem comercialmente junto a empresas consumidoras de energia.

Serão especialmente valorizados parceiros que possuam:

  • Experiência nos setores de energia, utilities, sustentabilidade, infraestrutura ou serviços B2B;
  • Experiência em vendas consultivas;
  • Atuação junto a empresas com consumo relevante de energia;
  • Forte presença comercial ou institucional em determinada região ou segmento econômico.


Informações adicionais

A relação será estabelecida por meio de parceria comercial independente, sem exclusividade e sem vínculo empregatício.

A remuneração será baseada exclusivamente no êxito comercial, de acordo com os negócios originados pelo parceiro e efetivamente convertidos em clientes, conforme regras previamente estabelecidas entre as partes.

jobs.description:
Company introduction:

Compass Pathways plc (Nasdaq: CMPS) is a biotechnology company dedicated to unlocking urgently needed new treatment options in mental health care.

The Company is headquartered in London, UK, with a U.S. office in New Jersey. We believe mental health patients deserve the possibility of a better future. Our initial focus is developing COMP360 psilocybin, a proprietary, investigational, synthetic psilocybin treatment under evaluation for treatment-resistant depression (TRD) and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). COMP360 is a potentially first-in-class treatment and has Breakthrough Therapy designation from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), as well as Innovative Licensing and Access Pathway (ILAP) designation in the UK for TRD.

We are leading the world’s largest classic psychedelic clinical program in TRD, and building upon that robust foundation, we are executing a late-stage trial evaluating COMP360 for PTSD, another condition with high unmet need. Our goal is to advance treatments that move the field of psychiatry towards treatment options that offer rapid onset and sustained durability with infrequent dosing. -Compass Pathways

Job overview:

The Associate Director, Scientific Communications will help to optimize and execute the Scientific Communications function within Medical Affairs, stewarding the capabilities, processes, and scientific communications that support launch readiness and future growth. This individual will translate emerging clinical and scientific evidence into clear, compelling, and scientifically rigorous communications that advance Medical Affairs strategy and scientific exchange.

Success in this role requires equal parts strategic thinking and hands-on execution. Working closely with the Executive Director of Medical Affairs, the Associate Director will help shape scientific communications strategy while personally owning key deliverables, including publications, congress materials, scientific platforms, slide decks, FAQs, and medical education resources. The role requires a balance of strategic thinking and practical execution, partnering across Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, HEOR, Regulatory, Legal, Compliance, and Field Medical to continuously improve publication planning, congress planning, and scientific communications processes that enable timely, consistent, and impactful dissemination of scientific evidence.

We are seeking a scientifically rigorous, intellectually curious, and creative team player who is energized by the opportunity to build something new. The ideal candidate enjoys solving complex challenges, values diverse perspectives, and combines scientific excellence with thoughtful design to create engaging, high-impact scientific communications that ultimately improve patient care.

Location:Remote in the United States.

Reports to:Executive Director, Medical Affairs.

Roles and responsibilities(Includes but not limited to):

Stewardship of the Scientific Communications Function

  • Drive the defined Scientific Communications plans within Medical Affairs, contributing to scalable processes and capabilities to support launch and long-term growth
  • Partner with Medical Affairs leadership to develop and execute an integrated Scientific Communications strategy aligned with organizational priorities
  • Identify opportunities to improve how scientific information is communicated by introducing thoughtful, innovative approaches that enhance clarity, quality, and impact
  • Vendor selection and management, and engagement with external thought leader collaborators

Publications Planning and Scientific Dissemination

  • Lead publication planning and execution across the Medical Affairs portfolio, ensuring timely and effective dissemination of scientific evidence
  • Refine and continuously improve publication planning processes, governance, and execution in collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders
  • Partner with internal subject matter experts, Clinical Development, and external authors to develop manuscripts, abstracts, posters, and oral presentations in accordance with compliance policies
  • Monitor publication timelines and proactively identify risks, opportunities, and dependencies

Congress Scientific Planning and Execution

  • Lead scientific planning for key medical congresses in partnership with cross-functional teams
  • Coordinate congress scientific communications with publication plans and organizational priorities
  • Support the development of abstracts, posters, presentations, and related scientific content
  • Ensure congress activities maximize scientific engagement and effective dissemination of new evidence

High-Impact Scientific Communications

  • Collaborate closely with the Field Medical organization to develop high-quality scientific communications that support scientific exchange
  • Develop and maintain scientific slide decks, FAQs, educational resources, advisory board materials, presentations, and other Medical Affairs communications
  • Translate complex scientific and clinical data into accurate, engaging communications tailored to diverse scientific audiences
  • Ensure scientific consistency across Medical Affairs communications through thoughtful review and content stewardship

Scientific Communication Platforms

  • Own and continuously evolve the Treatment-Resistant Depression Scientific Communications Platform as the scientific foundation for Medical Affairs communications
  • Partner with internal scientific leaders to develop and maintain the PTSD Scientific Communications Platform
  • Ensure emerging scientific evidence is appropriately integrated into communication platforms and core Medical Affairs materials

Candidate Profile:

  • Advanced scientific degree (PharmD, PhD, MD, DO, PsyD, or equivalent) in a relevant scientific discipline
  • Minimum 8 years experience in Medical Affairs, Scientific Communications, Publications, or a related function within the biopharmaceutical industry and/or scientific/medical communications agency
  • Demonstrated experience leading publication planning and execution, including manuscripts, abstracts, posters, and scientific presentations
  • Experience supporting scientific communications for major medical congresses
  • Exceptional scientific writing, editing, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear and compelling scientific communications
  • Prior leadership experience in Scientific Communications is strongly preferred with demonstrated success managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are an early-stage wearable sensing startup building a body-worn sensing platform at the frontier of hardware engineering. This is a pivotal moment for the company, and we're looking for a technically deep, hands-on Head of Engineering to own technical execution from architecture through shipping — while leading a distributed team across India and San Francisco.

You'll be based full-time in India and travel to San Francisco approximately one week per month. This role is for someone who thrives at the intersection of systems thinking, embedded hardware, and team leadership — and who has a proven track record of shipping real products into real users' hands.

Note: This role is open to US citizens and US visa holders only. Visa sponsorship is not available.

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end technical execution of a body-worn sensing platform — from system architecture through production shipment.

  • Lead and coordinate a distributed team of hardware, firmware, and mechanical specialists across India and San Francisco.

  • Make weekly design and integration decisions across power systems, sensor synchronization, firmware/embedded Linux, and mechanical structure.

  • Define and maintain the complete hardware system architecture, ensuring all subsystems integrate coherently into a wearable product.

  • Translate product requirements into clear, precise engineering briefs for the distributed team to execute against.

  • Review and critique mechanical designs with engineering justification, focusing on wearability, durability, and real-world deployment constraints.

  • Debug firmware and system-level issues using schematics, logic analyzers, and serial logs.

  • Shape hiring criteria and interview processes to grow overall team capability.

  • Own meaningful systems from day one and measure direct impact on product quality and model capabilities.

What We're Looking For

Dealbreakers (all required):

  • US citizen or US visa holder.

  • 6+ years of hardware engineering experience focused on wearable hardware, robotics, motion capture, or field-deployed devices.

  • Hands-on experience designing multi-rail battery-powered hardware, including power protection circuits, regulator topology selection, and ability to analyze inrush/brownout behavior on first power-on; must be comfortable reading schematics.

  • At least one hardware product shipped from first prototype to real users.

  • Willing to live in India and travel to San Francisco approximately one week per month.

Required:

  • Experience operating as a staff, principal, or founding engineer — not solely as an engineering manager.

  • Proven ability to lead distributed teams across time zones and maintain engineering quality without daily in-person presence.

  • Deep expertise in sensor synchronization across mismatched sample rates and variable bus latencies, including firmware-level timestamping and diagnosing real misalignment in datasets.

  • Firmware and embedded Linux experience: bringing up SoM/SBC platforms, debugging timing, interrupt, and buffer issues.

  • Strong mechanical judgment: able to critique load paths, tolerance stack-up, strain relief, and wearable-specific requirements.

  • Strong communication skills with a demonstrated ability to translate product needs into precise engineering briefs and influence hiring decisions.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with supply chain and vendor management for hardware components.

  • Experience with regulatory compliance (UL/IEC) for wearable devices.

  • Experience shipping hardware at scale, including mass production and manufacturing handoff.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: $140,000 – $210,000 USD annually

  • Competitive equity in an early-stage company at a pivotal growth stage

  • Regular travel to San Francisco (approximately one week per month) covered by the company

Location

This is a full-time, on-site role based in India. You will travel to San Francisco, CA, USA approximately one week per month to collaborate with the local team. Candidates must already be located in or willing to relocate to India.

Trusted by 20,000+ property managers worldwide, Hostaway is an industry leading, AI-powered vacation rental management platform designed for professional short-term rental operators. Hostaway brings everything together for greater efficiency and faster growth.

Profitable, high-growth, and the first short-term rental Property Management System unicorn. Join us at our most exciting stage yet! Learn more about our recent valuation and story here.

About the role

Hostaway is a customer centric company with our clients at the heart of everything we do. We are design driven, and the way we design has changed. We are in constant contact with users, we use AI across the whole workflow, and we want to move from a problem to something real and testable in days rather than weeks.

As a Senior Product Designer you own projects end to end, from discovery through delivery and into the data once something is live. You stay close to customers on a regular basis, frame the opportunities worth solving, and pressure test your thinking with evidence rather than opinion. You use AI as a genuine part of how you work, to synthesise research, explore more directions faster, and build functional prototypes you can put in front of real users, not just static screens. The mindset is that your output should be functional, desirable and created with a high level of craft that we will iterate and improve on.

You will play a key role in shaping what the team delivers and how we deliver it, holding quality and consistency across our product. You build real empathy with our users, understand how they actually work, and turn insight from many sources into a clear story about what to build and why.

Success here means combining deep user understanding with a strong bias to action. You solve real problems, you craft interfaces people love to use, and you ship at pace without losing rigour.

What you’ll do

  • Lead projects from discovery to delivery: Stay in regular contact with customers, map opportunities, and carry work all the way through to delivery and post launch analysis.

  • Work AI-first: Use AI tools across research synthesis, ideation, writing, and prototyping to explore more, decide faster, and free up your time for the hard design problems.

  • Build and ship fast: Go beyond static screens to build interactive, working prototypes, put them in front of real users early, and iterate. Speed of learning is how we win.

  • Uncover user needs: Combine qualitative and quantitative evidence to guide your decisions and know when a direction is not supported.

  • Drive alignment: Facilitate workshops, focus the team, move decisions forward, and develop solutions that work for the business, the user, and engineering.

  • Think system-wide: Contribute to and maintain our design system, while considering the broader product ecosystem in everything you ship.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, engineers, and customer success, to identify user needs and deliver impactful design solutions.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in a product design role, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment.

  • Fluent in AI tooling; from leveraging AI tools for customer discovery and problem definition to AI-assisted prototyping ensuring a design process that leverages AI insights and accelerates innovation.

  • Strong research, storytelling, mapping, and blueprinting skills, with deep empathy for our clients. You know what drives them, what they expect, and how to design in ways that improve their workflows and efficiency.

  • Strong visual and interface skills, with proven experience designing complex functional interfaces where clarity, hierarchy, and usability matter as much as craft.

  • A strong bias towards action; managing multiple projects simultaneously with strong self-prioritisation skills.

  • Highly proficient in Figma and its functionalities, especially auto-layout.

  • Experience working in agile environments.

  • Vibe-coding experience is a plus.

What we offer

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive pay based on market rates in the country of the applicant.

  • 100% Remote: Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere within your country of residence—be it a co-working space, your home office, or even your dining room table. The choice is yours. Just don’t ask to work in our office (we don’t have one).

  • Equity: Every role in our company comes with valuable stock options in a fast-growing and profitable company. This ensures we all share in the company’s success.

  • Values-Driven Leadership: Our Core Values are not just words we’ve written to make us feel good. We leverage them daily when making strategic and tactical decisions.

  • Professional Growth: Our rapid growth offers unparalleled learning and development opportunities, along with a multitude of career advancement opportunities.

  • Annual Paid Leave: The specific amounts vary by country and are aligned with country and/or contract-specific norms.

  • Geographic Specific Benefits: As an international employer, we offer different country-specific benefits such as Health Insurance and Pensions in countries where these perks are customary. The specifics depend on the country of the applicant.

  • Dynamic Team Culture: As a global company with team members in over 40 countries, our diverse and international culture fuels our innovation and creativity, providing a key pillar to our success (and making it a lot of fun to work here).

Thank you for your interest. If you apply for this role, you will receive an email from our Talent Acquisition team after your application has been reviewed alongside the qualifications for this role and the qualifications of others who have applied.

jobs.description:
If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Specialist Underwriter - Planning Unit Operations (PUO)

Portfolio Underwriting & Optimization is a specialized department within the Contract Property & Casualty underwriting organization. The PUO team is responsible for driving profitable growth through strategic book management by applying technical underwriting expertise and various data driven analysis with the goal to identify and deliver underwriting actions that align with business strategy.

General responsibilities for a PUO underwriter include the following:

  • Management/assisting of assigned LOB/segment and identifies, coordinates, and delivers on product, appetite, and pricing optimization changes to the portfolio
  • Ensuring rate strategy implementation and execution for assigned LOB/segment
  • Utilize data tools, reporting and external resources and publications to identify trends and make recommendations to improve profitability
  • Collaborate with underwriting and agency partners to solicit feedback on new product and program opportunities
  • Collaborate with Product and technology partners to drive successful implementation of product enhancements in underwriting systems and ensure system behavior supports underwriting intent
  • Collaborate with Product on the design and development of new forms and standalone product/program offerings
  • Provide recommendations for future audits based on existing portfolio trends or retrospective portfolio reviews
  • Participate in claims roundtables, agency visits/agency calls to proactively identify, research and solution for trends/opportunities in assigned segment(s)
  • Attending industry conferences and events
  • Assist/manage Alternative Distribution book as needed.

The candidate for this role should have 6 years related experience or 5 years as an Underwriter and should have prior experience in Commercial P&C Excess & Surplus lines underwriting with:

  • Commercial E&S P&C underwriting and product knowledge
  • Ability to identify, manage and solution for trends within a book of business
  • Understanding of underwriting operations and underwriting systems
  • Familiarity with ISO and other industry resources
  • Data analysis and identifying an impact on book performance
  • Manage projects and prioritize multiple tasks under tight deadlines
  • Be a self-starter who takes initiative to improve quality, processes, and communication
  • Be a proficient communicator and have the skills and ability to explain a complex concept to a broad audience
  • Effective in managing ambiguity with the ability to operate under limited direction
  • Have strong rapport with other departments and collaborate with them on project work
  • Accountable for performance of subset/segment of larger vertical

*This role does not qualify for employer-sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the Stem OPT Extension program.*

Job Description Summary

Are you a critical thinker who can analyze complex risk and find insurance solutions that balance customer needs with business goals? If you can take initiative, use both your analytical and creative abilities to make sound decisions and have a desire to help people solve real challenges, we want to hear from you!

Our Excess & Surplus/Specialty (E&S/S) lines allow us to provide insurance that other carriers may not offer. It’s a fast-paced environment in a collaborative, team-oriented culture, working in an always-changing, growing industry.

As an Underwriting Specialist in Contract you determine individual risk acceptability, pricing, coverage, terms and conditions, by developing, analyzing and evaluating information and exposures on risks of a complex technical nature for the assigned line of business. In addition, you’ll achieve production and loss ratio goals with assigned general agents or program managers by reviewing and analyzing claims, loss history and taking appropriate action on accounts. General agent assignments are more complex in terms of coverage and general agent relationships. It’s important to establish and maintain effective relationships with general agents to generate premium dollars and profitability. You will work independently with a high level of authority and judgment. Determining appropriate reinsurance placement, if any, on individual accounts is an important element of this role. We will count on you to foster positive business relationships with co-workers, general agents and reinsurers. You will also assist with research, development and presentation of new products, forms and manuals and have opportunities to assist in the training and mentoring of Underwriters and Underwriting Assistants.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Reviews individual risks with assigned agents or programs within assigned territory and either declines or accepts business based upon information necessary to make the decision. The underwriter analyzes, with a high level of technical expertise, exposures to loss, develops an adequate premium charge for the exposure and determines appropriate endorsements and exclusions to address loss exposures for the insurance contract. Within department guidelines, places reinsurance, if any, for the account.

  • Achieves individual production and loss ratio goals within assigned territory through sound territory management and marketing. Achieves production, profitability and service objectives. Quotes, prices and underwrites new and renewal policies and endorsements, primarily for complex or service sensitive accounts. Monitors risk selection and pricing decisions for entire agency plant, both on a book of business and individual account level basis. Works with more complex issues concerning coverage, programs, agents and program managers. The underwriter continually analyzes premium and loss results in their territory or assigned agents by agency, state, major class of business and by program. Continually assess quality of submissions and makes corrective action recommendations. Development and implementation of specific action plans may be required

  • Handles policy maintenance items and other mid-term requests. Reviews endorsement requests and processes necessary changes to the policy. Reviews loss control reports and makes recommendations to the agent and/or changes to the policy. Follows up on outstanding information as required. Reviews claim activity and takes appropriate action. May review agency books of business as well as profit/growth results and trends to recommend and implement action plans.

  • Fosters positive business relationships with general agents through daily contact with assigned agents by developing and maintaining good rapport and resolving agency conflicts. Travels to agency offices as required for audits, training or marketing visits. Entertains agents visiting the Company as required. Assists with development of marketing ideas and strategies for underwriting seminars and other marketing campaigns.

  • Places reinsurance per department guidelines based upon the appropriate use of all reinsurance facilities used by the department, including various treaty semiautomatic and facultative reinsurance. Maintains good working relationship with reinsurers.

  • Markets Nationwide products and services to help drive agency and company results, including all enterprise products that may enhance offerings. Assists agency with strategies for pipeline management, producer development and to develop new business in targeted industries and preferred markets. Responds effectively to assess accounts and develop business propositions that win the business.

  • Other responsibilities as assigned may include program research and development, form development, rate development, technical assistance to Agents, Underwriting Assistants, and other Underwriters. Proactively develops technical and business knowledge through internal and external venues

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Department Manager

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Undergraduate degree preferred. Equivalent work experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.

License/Certification/Designation: Completion of general insurance courses such as CPCU, CIC, AU, ARM, CPIW, CWIS, or ASLI is preferred.

Experience: Six years related experience or five years as an underwriter, excess & surplus lines preferred.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Knowledge of lines underwriting policies, practices and procedures, insurance law and underwriting marketing principles and techniques, rating plans and plan concepts, Treaty & Facultative reinsurance concepts, general agency system and company operations, regulatory issues, the general agency system, market conditions and company operations. Ability to communicate effectively, orally, and in writing, interpersonally with individuals and groups via telephone, fax, e-mail and in person. Demonstrates advanced negotiation skills. Ability to manage the assigned line or lines of business, which may include monitoring of aggregates. Ability to work with the wholesale/general agency distribution system. Ability to analyze insurance risks to determine acceptability including policy language, various commercial rating plans and methodologies, reinsurance. Ability to use/learn job related computer software. Ability to devise business solutions to problems, implement the most appropriate, and monitor its effectiveness. Ability to make decisions with minimal supervision.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and HR Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Not Eligible (Exempt)

Working Conditions: Normal office environment. Travel out of state as required several times a year. In-town entertaining required as necessary after 5:00 P.M.

Total Healthcare. Where you live.

This position operates in a dyad partnership with the Market Medical Director. The Market Medical Director owns clinical decisions, clinical quality, and patient safety, while the Market Operations Director owns operational and administrative execution.   • Project-management experience

  • Experience working with property managers, community organizations, payers, or other external stakeholders

  • Experience supporting healthcare delivery within underserved communities

  • Experience leading operations in a rapidly growing or transforming healthcare organization

What Success Looks Like

  • Establishing reliable and accountable operations across Matter Health’s Massachusetts market

  • Achieving market-level financial, engagement, access, productivity, staffing, and execution goals

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer .NET / Docker (f/m/d) - Remote in Germany
jobs.excerpt: Synera ships today as a desktop app.  Your job is to change that — lift the backend into containers, build the on-prem server product from its first commit, and make the whole platform a breeze to operate.
jobs.description:
Synera ships today as a desktop app. Your job is to change that — lift the backend into containers, build the on-prem server product from its first commit, and make the whole platform a breeze to operate. If you've ever looked at a monolith and thought "I know how to take this apart," this is the role. 🚀


WHAT YOU WILL DO

Synera is the leading AI Agent Platform for Engineering — companies like BMW, Airbus, NASA, and Hyundai use it to build autonomous digital engineers that execute real work inside CAD, CAE, and PLM tools. Today the product runs as a Windows desktop application. We're building a server-hosted product customers can deploy on their own infrastructure, and you'll join the team that owns the transition end to end.

You'll be the first engineer on our new Platform team. That means extracting the .NET backend from its desktop dependencies, containerizing it with Docker, and standing up the CI/CD, install, upgrade, and licensing flows for on-prem deployment as well as taking over auth tasks. In parallel, you'll join our efforts to make the platform AI-native: building MCP servers, agent skills, and documentation written for AI agents — not just humans — to operate the platform. As the work matures, you'll contribute to growing a small, senior team around it.

You'll report to Ben and work closely with Sven and the broader engineering org, including being part of the Chaotic Chimeras team in the beginning. This is real ownership: you drive work to a finished, deployed state and raise blockers early.

👉 What a week at Synera could look like:

  • Monday: Daily standup with the Chimeras team, then a deep focus block untangling the backend from its desktop dependencies. Every other Monday you join the cross-team dev share to swap learnings with engineers from the other teams.

  • Tuesday: Heads-down getting a service running headless inside a multi-stage Docker image. On alternating Tuesdays the team runs an AI experimentation day — you point a new agent or tool at a real platform workflow and see what sticks.

  • Wednesday: Work on the CI/CD pipeline so images build, test, and publish on their own.

  • Thursday: Sprint review and planning. You demo the latest slice of the migration, scope the next one, then work on the on-prem install flow — upgrade, rollback, and licensing for a customer-run server.

  • Friday: Every other Friday afternoon is yours for upskilling — a conference talk, a new tool, or a book from your €2,000 development budget.

⚡ In 6 months:

  • The backend runs headless in Docker across dev, test, and staging — fully lifted out of its desktop dependencies.

  • A first on-prem deployment is live in an internal or friendly-customer environment, and CI/CD builds, tests, and publishes images without anyone babysitting it.

  • The platform's first MCP server or agent skill is in use, with deployment docs written for AI agents to act on.

⚡ In 12 months:

  • Customers install, upgrade, and roll back the on-prem server themselves — the migration is proven end to end at a real customer site.

  • The Platform team has grown to two or three engineers, and the standards and onboarding you wrote make them productive fast.

  • MCPs and agent skills cover the main deploy and operations workflows, and internal teams reach for them day to day.

  • Observability is live in production, not just planned. Telemetry giving real visibility into every deployed instance, so "is it healthy" is a dashboard, not a Slack message to you.

  • First steps are made towards a fully cloud-native Infrastructure setup, that could power a SaaS solution.

Here is our team at the summer event - join us at the next one! 👋

🌱 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

We believe in transparent conversations about compensation from the start. For this role, our planned salary ranges are:

  • X Level: X - Y EUR annually

  • X Level: X - Y EUR annually

We determine the level we hire you for based on your experience, the scope of responsibilities you'll take on, and the impact you can drive. While we typically hire within these bands, we're open to some flexibility for candidates who bring exceptional value to the role.

Check out this page to learn how we approach salary, career growth, and creating an environment where everyone can shine.

What we offer beyond salary:

  • Flexible working: you decide when & where to work (as long as you have a residency in Germany).

  • Flexible public holidays: swap days off according to your values and beliefs!

  • Home office setup support + access to our office in Bremen.

  • Personal development budget of €2,000 to attend conferences and trainings or buy interesting books to improve in an area of your choice.

  • We don't count your vacation days, as we trust all our team members to decide what's best for them and the company.

  • Prefer two wheels over four? 🚲 We’ve got you covered with JobRad.

  • To support your personal and professional well-being, we offer company fitness with Wellpass and mental health platform nilo.

  • Regular team events, virtual coffee breaks, and spontaneous afterworks. We also get together as a whole company for 2-3 day off-sites twice a year! 🌈

Requirements

🚀 WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Even if you don't meet these criteria perfectly but believe you have lots to bring to the role, we encourage you to apply. We know it's tough, but please keep in mind that you don't have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

  • You resonate with Synera's Core Values - they're central to how we work, and we'll explore them together in your first interview.

  • You have 5+ years of experience building backend software in C#/.NET.

  • You have a track record of decoupling backend logic from a UI or desktop layer — extracting services, removing hard dependencies, making code run headless and under test.

  • You've containerized production applications with Docker (multi-stage builds, Linux images, image-size control) — beyond tutorial level.

  • You've built and owned CI/CD pipelines that teams rely on.

  • You've packaged software for environments the vendor doesn't control: on-prem or customer-hosted install, upgrade, configuration, and secrets management.

  • You work AI-native: you use AI tooling in your daily engineering and want to build agent-facing tooling for the platform.

  • You work autonomously and drive work to a finished, deployed state.

  • You're fluent in English at professional working proficiency.

P.S. Synera is a place where everyone can grow. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come to work every day, and be prepared to share with us how your perspective will bring something unique and valuable to our R&D team.

AltoVita’s unique offering sets us apart in the market, providing a network of 10 million+ verified and vetted properties are all duty of care compliant, backed by a four-tier quality control process; located in over 35,000 cities & 165 countries world-wide. With our award-winning enterprise software and human-centric approach, we deliver smart and sustainable solutions to global talent mobility & business travel managers worldwide.

  • Reservations knowledge will be a plus.

  • Ability to work independently.

Ways of Working

AltoVita is a fully remote team. Although we have regular touch-points throughout the week, organise off-sites in several locations, trust is essential for us to work effectively as a team. Our founders empower us to make decisions autonomously, and in turn expect that we also empower our direct reports.

DVT is a leading technology consulting and software engineering company delivering innovative solutions across Africa and internationally. We partner with clients to solve complex business challenges through software engineering, cloud platforms, data, artificial intelligence, and digital transformation. Our teams combine deep technical expertise with a strong consulting mindset to create measurable business value.

We are looking for an experienced Microsoft Fabric Cloud Platform Engineer to help clients establish, automate, and operationalise Microsoft Fabric environments using cloud engineering best practices.

This role is ideal for a cloud platform engineer who enjoys building secure, scalable foundations for data and analytics teams. You will work closely with cloud, security, architecture, and data engineering teams to design and implement Microsoft Fabric platforms that are reliable, governed, and ready for enterprise adoption.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement Microsoft Fabric platform foundations, including capacities, workspaces, OneLake, environment structures, and platform configuration.

  • Establish and manage DEV, TEST, and PROD environments and deployment strategies.

  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and other automation technologies.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.

  • Implement security, identity, and access controls using Microsoft Entra ID and RBAC.

  • Integrate Microsoft Fabric with Azure services and broader cloud platforms.

  • Develop reusable automation and deployment patterns to ensure consistency and scalability.

  • Support monitoring, logging, operational readiness, and platform governance.

  • Collaborate with Data Engineering teams to enable workloads and remove platform barriers.

  • Produce technical documentation, standards, and operational runbooks.

  • Provide technical leadership and guidance on Fabric platform architecture and engineering practices.

Essential Experience & Qualifications Required

  • 5+ years of Azure Cloud Engineering experience.

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Azure certifications would be advantageous.

  • Terraform, DevOps, or cloud platform certifications are beneficial.

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric and its core platform components.

  • Experience implementing Fabric capacities, workspaces, and OneLake.

  • Strong Terraform and Infrastructure as Code experience.

  • Experience with Azure DevOps and/or GitHub CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience implementing Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, and cloud security controls.

  • Experience designing and managing Fabric environments across DEV, TEST, and PROD.

  • Strong understanding of cloud networking, security, governance, and operational best practices.

  • Experience automating cloud platforms using PowerShell and/or Python.

  • Experience working within enterprise cloud environments.

  • Good understanding of data platform concepts and how data workloads consume cloud infrastructure.

Advantageous Experience

  • Experience establishing a Microsoft Fabric platform from the ground up.

  • Experience with Fabric REST APIs and platform automation.

  • Experience integrating Fabric with Azure services.

  • Understanding of data ingestion workloads and notebook-based solutions within Fabric.

  • Experience working in regulated or governed cloud environments.

  • Exposure to FinOps and cloud cost optimisation practices.

  • Experience collaborating across Cloud Engineering, Data Engineering, Security, and Architecture teams.

Important to Know

This is a Cloud Platform Engineering role, not a Data Engineering role. The primary focus is establishing, automating, securing, and operating the Microsoft Fabric platform rather than building data pipelines, analytics models, or reporting solutions.

$70,000 - $80,000 per annum 📋 Campaign Delivery 🏬 Operations

native has been building for 10 years, but we're still very much a startup: fast-moving, ambitious, and building with intent. We're creating the infrastructure that connects students, Students’ Unions, universities, and advertisers through a managed marketplace.

Our goal is to deliver for students by increasing student engagement while enabling Students’ Unions to secure sustainable funding. For advertisers, we offer meaningful, measurable routes to student audiences. The more aligned these incentives are, the more defensible and scalable our business becomes.

This is initially a fixed-term role during a key period of growth, with the potential to develop into a permanent Campaign Manager opportunity.

The Opportunity

We're hiring a Campaign Delivery Manager on a 3 month FTC for someone who will take ownership of delivering a portfolio of US campaigns, working across our teams, campus partners, suppliers and on-the-ground event staff to turn campaign plans into brilliant execution.

It's a hands-on project management role for someone who loves making things happen. One day you might be coordinating the final details of a campus activation; the next, managing suppliers, briefing an Event Manager or solving a last-minute delivery challenge.

You'll work closely with our UK-based Central Operations team, becoming an important part of the bridge between our UK and US operations. As one of our key delivery contacts during US working hours, you'll also be there when campaigns are live, helping teams on the ground, responding to questions and making sure issues are dealt with quickly.

We're looking for someone who can get up to speed quickly, take genuine ownership and thrive in an environment where there is plenty happening at once.

What you’ll be working on

As Campaign Delivery Manager, you’ll be responsible for the following:

  • Manage the end-to-end delivery of experiential and integrated campaigns

    across the US.

  • Turn campaign briefs into clear delivery plans, timelines and actions.

  • Coordinate all the moving parts required to deliver a great campaign, from staffing, production and logistics to campus requirements and suppliers.

  • Work with our Campus Partners and Partnerships team to understand requirements, secure approvals and make sure activations are ready to go.

  • Brief and manage Event Managers, Brand Ambassadors and other teams delivering campaigns on the ground.

  • Work closely with colleagues across Campaign Planning, Central Operations, Creative Production, Staffing, Partnerships and Commercial.

  • Keep clients and internal stakeholders confident in delivery through clear, proactive communication.

  • Manage multiple live campaigns at different stages, keeping timelines, trackers and key information accurate and up to date.

  • Be a key point of contact for delivery during US working hours, supporting teams on the ground and responding to live campaign queries.

  • Spot risks early, solve problems quickly and escalate when something needs wider support.

  • Make sure campaigns are delivered safely, professionally, on brand and in line with what we've promised.

  • Ensure campaign evidence and Proof of Delivery are captured so we can demonstrate the impact of our work.

What we’re looking for

You'll already have experience delivering experiential campaigns, events, brand activations, field marketing or similarly fast-moving projects and be ready to take the next step in your career.

You'll be someone who is comfortable being given an outcome and working out what needs to happen to get there.

Specifically, you will bring:

  • Strong campaign or project management experience.

  • Experience coordinating multiple projects, campaigns or events at the same

    time.

  • A good understanding of experiential delivery and the practicalities behind

    live activations.

  • Excellent organisation and attention to detail.

  • Confidence working with clients, suppliers, partners and on-the-ground

    teams.

  • Strong written and verbal communication.

  • A calm, practical approach when plans change or problems need solving.

  • The ability to prioritise and make decisions in a fast-moving environment.

  • Confidence working independently while being part of a wider international

    team.

  • A collaborative attitude and willingness to get stuck in wherever needed.

Required skills & experience

We are committed to lifting everyone up. We seek to enable people’s best work by optimising for freedom with accountability. You’ll get the most out of this role if you can bring:

  • Experience working with university or college campuses, student audiences or multi-location campaigns would be a bonus, but isn't essential.


Whats in it for you

💰 Base Salary: $70,000 - $80,000 per annum

👨🏽‍💻 Employment through EOR partner

🏡 Remote-first role in the US

⚡ Opportunity to work in a dynamic, fast-growing startup.

jobs.excerpt: Role Description The Revenue Cycle Follow-Up Representative is responsible for ensuring timely and accurate follow-up on both Professional Billing (PB/CMS-1500) and/or Hospital Billing (HB/UB-04) claims.
jobs.description:
Role Description

The Revenue Cycle Follow-Up Representative is responsible for ensuring timely and accurate follow-up on both Professional Billing (PB/CMS-1500) and/or Hospital Billing (HB/UB-04) claims. This role manages accounts receivable, resolves unpaid and underpaid claims, and drives reimbursement from government and commercial payers. The ideal candidate has strong knowledge of 837P/837I transaction sets, EOB/ERA reconciliation, and payer-specific follow-up requirements.

Roles & Responsibilities

Claim Follow-Up – PB & HB

  • Monitor and follow up on outstanding PB (CMS-1500 / 837P) and HB (UB-04 / 837I) claims via phone calls, payer websites, and Epic work queues to ensure timely reimbursement.
  • Investigate and resolve unpaid, underpaid, and rejected claims by working with insurance providers and internal departments.
  • Analyze account history and all previous actions in Epic prior to taking the next action step to resolve the claim.
  • Identify payer trends and payment discrepancies across both PB and HB claim types and escalate findings to leadership.
  • Understand when claim corrections, rebilling (837P or 837I), and resubmissions are applicable.
  • Escalate claims with payers for resolution on inaccurate or delayed claim processing.

Appeals & Reconsiderations

  • Submit reconsiderations and/or appeals for both PB and HB claims with appropriate attachments, documentation, and clinical justification.
  • Adhere to payer-specific appeal deadlines and formatting requirements for Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payers.

Payer & System Knowledge

  • Navigate Epic to manage HB and PB work queues, document follow-up activity, and review 835 remittance/ERA data.
  • Utilize payer portals (Availity, NaviMedix, Arkansas DHS portal, and others) to verify claim status and obtain EOBs.
  • Utilize resources provided by the client to promote accuracy and resolve claims in accordance with client expectations.

Compliance & Documentation

  • Ensure accurate and detailed documentation of all follow-up activities in Epic.
  • Communicate with insurance companies, patients, and internal teams to resolve claims and promote cash collections.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and payer regulations, as well as hospital and physician practice policies.
  • Always maintain confidentiality of patient and account information (HIPAA).
  • Adhere to prescribed policies and procedures outlined in the Employee Handbook and Code of Conduct.
  • Maintain awareness of and actively participate in the Corporate Compliance Program.
  • Maintain a confidential and orderly remote work area.
  • Meet specified goals and objectives assigned by management and/or the Client.
  • Assist with other projects as assigned by management.

Expected / Key Results

  • Deliver high levels of client and patient satisfaction (CSAT)
  • Achieve quality scores per defined process standards
  • Deliver defined process-specific metrics (e.g., AR days, cash collected, productivity units)
  • Adherence to regulatory compliance requirements
  • Schedule adherence

Preferred Educational Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Health Information Management, Business, or related field preferred

Preferred Work Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in healthcare revenue cycle, claims processing, or AR follow-up
  • Demonstrated experience working PB (CMS-1500 / 837P) and/or HB (UB-04 / 837I) claim follow-up
  • Prior experience with Epic billing and/or follow-up work queues strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with Medicaid, Medicare, and commercial payers preferred
  • Experience reading and interpreting 835 ERA / EOB remittance data

Competencies & Skills

  • Strong knowledge of PB and HB billing workflows, claim lifecycle, and payer follow-up processes
  • Proficiency with Epic (HB and/or PB modules, work queues, claim correction, and rebilling)
  • Familiarity with CARC/RARC denial and adjustment reason codes
  • Ability to interpret EOB, ERA (835), and remittance advice for both PB and HB claims
  • Knowledge of payer portals including Availity, Arkansas DHS, and commercial payer sites
  • Competent in working and communicating effectively with payers, patients, colleagues, and management – both in-person and via remote virtual platforms
  • Consistently maintains a courteous and professional demeanor
  • Self-motivated with the ability to stay focused and productive with minimal supervision
  • Proactive initiative and creative problem-solving in carrying out job responsibilities
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks through effective time management and organizational skills
  • Proficiency in PC operations; ability to type at a rate of 30–40 words per minute

Benefits including but not limited to: Medical, Vision, Dental, 401K, Paid Time Off.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

Not Accepting Referrals

jobs.excerpt: About the Role We are looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to build, execute, optimize, and report on a global demand generation engine in a fast-paced B2B SaaS environment focused on compliance and financial services.
jobs.description:
About the Role
We are looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to build, execute, optimize, and report on a global demand generation engine in a fast-paced B2B SaaS environment focused on compliance and financial services. This role is ideal for a hands-on, data-driven growth marketer with 5–7+ years of experience who can connect audience strategy, campaign planning, HubSpot/Salesforce execution, lead nurturing, attribution, and sales handoff into one measurable revenue motion.
This person will partner closely with digital marketing, field marketing, product marketing, sales/CDR teams, marketing operations, and creative to launch programs that reach the right ICPs, generate qualified demand, and improve progression from inquiry to MQL, SQL, opportunity, and pipeline.

Responsibilities
  • Plan and execute full-funnel, multi-channel growth campaigns aligned to MCO business priorities, target segments, solution messaging, and pipeline goals.
  • Translate go-to-market priorities into clear campaign briefs with objectives, ICP/audience definition,
messaging themes, channel mix, conversion paths, timeline, owners, KPIs, and expected business outcomes.
  • Coordinate global campaign activity with regional field marketing so corporate programs, local activation,
ABM, events, and account engagement complement each other rather than overlap.
  • Build and manage campaigns in HubSpot, including emails, landing pages, forms, lists, segmentation,
workflows, nurture programs, lifecycle logic, and performance dashboards.
  • Ensure Salesforce campaign tracking is accurate and useful, including parent/child campaign structure,
campaign member status, source tracking, lifecycle progression, and attribution inputs.
  • Own campaign performance across the funnel, with emphasis on lead quality, MQL-to-SQL conversion,
sales-ready engagement, opportunity creation, and marketing-sourced / marketing-influenced pipeline.
  • Partner with Sales, CDRs, and Revenue Operations to ensure campaign leads are routed, scored, followed
up on, and measured consistently through the lifecycle.
  • Identify friction points in lead flow, attribution, campaign hierarchy, and sales handoff; recommend practical
improvements that increase conversion, speed-to-lead, pipeline velocity, and ROI.
  • Design and manage nurture programs using segmentation, behavioral triggers, personalization, lifecycle
stages, and content offers for prospects, event attendees, webinar participants, engaged contacts, dormant leads, customer expansion audiences, and priority accounts.
  • Work with product marketing and content to ensure campaigns are grounded in ICP needs, buyer personas,
priority use cases, competitive differentiation, and solution messaging.
  • Develop campaign reporting that connects activity to business outcomes, including engagement, conversion,
MQL volume and quality, MQL-to-SQL progression, opportunity creation, pipeline influence, cost per qualified lead, and ROI.
  • Present clear, actionable insights to marketing and sales stakeholders, moving beyond activity reporting to explain business impact, underperformance, optimization opportunities, and recommended next actions.
  • Maintain high QA discipline across campaign set-up, list segmentation, forms, workflows, UTMs, lead scoring, naming conventions, and reporting fields.

Experiences and Skills
  • 5–7+ years of experience in B2B campaign management, demand generation, growth marketing, or
integrated marketing; SaaS, fintech, compliance, regulatory technology, or financial services
experience preferred.
  • Hands-on HubSpot experience, including campaigns, forms, landing pages, lists, segmentation, email, workflows, nurture programs, reporting, and attribution.
  • Proven ability to plan and execute full-funnel campaigns across email, webinars, paid media, retargeting, landing pages, content syndication, events, ABM, and sales activation.
  • Strong understanding of MQL, SQL, opportunity creation, pipeline influence, attribution, conversion rates,
and campaign ROI.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate performance data into insights, recommendations, and optimization plans.
  • Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, stakeholders, and vendors simultaneously.
  • Clear communicator who can collaborate effectively with digital, field marketing, product marketing, content, creative, sales, CDRs, marketing operations, and agency partners.
  • Commercially curious and comfortable improving imperfect lead flow, reporting, attribution, and campaign processes while keeping day-to-day execution moving.

Preferred
  • Experience supporting global campaigns across multiple regions, personas, industries, product lines, or business units.
  • Experience with ABM, priority account activation, intent data, executive events, direct mail, or sales-led campaign plays.
  • Experience building executive-ready campaign dashboards or performance summaries.
  • Experience using AI tools to support campaign planning, audience research, content development, testing,
and performance analysis.
  • Exposure to compliance-driven messaging or marketing in regulated environments.

About MCO (MyComplianceOffice)
MCO is a global leader dedicated to empowering Financial Services firms to manage compliance programs with
ease and efficiency. Our mission is to foster a fair, transparent, and trusted financial environment worldwide by helping organizations meet their regulatory obligations to society.
At the heart of MCO’s offering is our unique, unified platform, which seamlessly integrates compliance monitoring and data into a single, comprehensive view. This holistic approach enables firms to maintain compliance across all
internal systems, structures, and processes—ensuring peace of mind in an ever-evolving regulatory landscape.
Headquartered in Dublin, MCO has an international footprint, with offices in London, Singapore, Hyderabad, New
York, Chicago, Fort Worth, Switzerland, South Africa, Slovenia, and the UAE. Since our founding in 2008, we have evolved from a specialist provider of “best of breed” employee compliance solutions to a pioneer in integrated compliance technology.
Today, our team of over 400 professionals supports more than 1.5 million users in 128 countries. Our diverse
customer base includes small businesses, large enterprises, four of the world’s top ten asset managers,
twenty of the top seventy-five global banks, and three of the top five investment banks for global M&A transactions.

We Do Consulting Differently


Coordinates and manages the collection, tracking, and organization of medical records and supporting documentation for medical billing and coding chart audits, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with regulatory requirements. Supports audit operations by maintaining audit tracking systems, facilitating communication among stakeholders, safeguarding protected health information (PHI), and helping ensure audit projects are completed efficiently and on schedule.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Manage the intake, organization, and tracking of medical records and supporting documentation required for medical billing and coding chart audits.
  • Review incoming documentation for completeness, accuracy, legibility, and compliance with audit requirements.
  • Identify missing, incomplete, or inconsistent documentation and coordinate follow-up requests with providers, clinics, and internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain audit tracking logs and workflow tools to monitor documentation status, audit progress, and completion timelines.
  • Serve as a liaison between audit staff, business development team, and engagement leads to facilitate timely receipt of required records.
  • Enter audit-related data into chart audit databases and tracking systems with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Update audit records, case statuses, and documentation inventories throughout the audit lifecycle.
  • Perform quality checks on data entry to ensure consistency, completeness, and adherence to established procedures.
  • Generate routine reports on documentation receipt rates, audit progress, outstanding requests, and project status.
  • Maintain organized electronic and physical filing systems for audit documentation in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Assist with preparation of audit reports and supporting materials for coding and clinical audit staff.
  • Monitor turnaround times and escalate delays or barriers that may impact audit deadlines.
  • Support process improvement initiatives by identifying workflow efficiencies and opportunities to improve documentation management.
  • Ensure confidentiality and secure handling of protected health information (PHI) in compliance with HIPAA and organizational standards.
  • Perform other administrative and operational support duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • 1-3 years of experience in administrative support, healthcare operations, medical records management, data entry, or a related field.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and database applications.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to maintaining data accuracy.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion.
  • Knowledge of HIPAA requirements and healthcare documentation practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with medical records, healthcare documentation, medical billing, coding, auditing, revenue cycle operations, or related healthcare functions.
  • Experience using document management systems, audit tracking tools, or healthcare databases.
  • Experience supporting audit, compliance, or quality assurance processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate documentation requests and collaborate with multiple stakeholders in a healthcare environment.

Working Conditions

While performing the duties of this role, the employee is regularly required to sit, use hands to handle or feel, and communicate effectively. The position is primarily sedentary and involves extended periods of working at a computer. The employee may occasionally need to stand, walk, or reach with hands and arms. Lifting or moving items up to 10 pounds may be required occasionally. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This role may operate in a professional office environment or a remote/home office setting, depending on business needs and company policy. The position routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, and other technology tools necessary for virtual collaboration. Employees are expected to maintain a safe and productive workspace, whether onsite or remote.

This is a hourly position, comp range: $75,000 – $85,000 equivalent.

Candidate must be able to submit verification of their legal right to work in the U.S., without company sponsorship now or in the future.

NVIDIA is the center of gravity of the AI infrastructure ecosystem, and vCluster is the tenancy layer that turns raw GPU infrastructure into secure, isolated, sellable cluster products - raising GPU utilization, compressing time-to-tenant from weeks to minutes, and delivering hard Tenant Isolation without hard silos for AI Clouds, sovereign AI builders, and enterprises. You will own the NVIDIA alliance end to end, worldwide: the strategy, the executive relationships, the integrations, the co-sell engine, and the number. Deals close in the field - your job is to make sure there are more of them, they are bigger, and they move faster because NVIDIA and vCluster are joined at the hip.

As a Global Alliance Director, NVIDIA, your role will include:

  • Owning the global alliance strategy: You will serve as vCluster's dedicated alliance owner and primary point of contact for NVIDIA - strategy, executive alignment, program agreements, and business reviews. You will build trusted relationships across NVIDIA's GTM leadership, solutions architecture, product and engineering, partner programs, and field sales, and continuously monitor NVIDIA's roadmap, open-source initiatives, and organizational changes to spot opportunities and mitigate risk before anyone else does.

  • Building the sell-to motion: You will champion vCluster's position inside NVIDIA's own AI infrastructure direction and platform stack - including NVIDIA's open-source AI factory frameworks and bare-metal tenancy initiatives, where vCluster and vMetal serve as the abstraction and experience layer - so vCluster becomes part of how NVIDIA builds and recommends AI factories.

  • Building the sell-with motion: You will design, launch, and scale repeatable co-sell plays targeting mutual customers across NVIDIA Cloud Partners (NCPs), GPU-specialized AI Clouds, sovereign AI programs, hyperscalers, and large enterprises building AI factories - driving account mapping, joint pipeline development, and field-to-field engagement, then connecting resulting opportunities to vCluster's regional sellers, channel partners, and OEM alliances to close.

  • Driving technical and marketing alignment: You will represent NVIDIA's technology requirements - DPU/DPF and BlueField data paths, DGX and SuperPOD environments, NVL-class systems, NVIDIA AI Enterprise - inside vCluster Product and Engineering, drive joint validation through NVIDIA's ISV and certification programs, and build the enablement engine that makes vCluster the easiest "yes" in an NVIDIA seller's deal.

  • Constructing multi-party ecosystem plays: You will build "4-in-a-box" plays that combine NVIDIA, vCluster, and OEM, storage, and GSI partners around real customer outcomes - joint reference architectures, co-marketing, and demand generation that NVIDIA sellers can run without us in the room.

  • Owning the partnership number: You will report partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, joint bookings contribution, integration and certification milestones, and field activation to vCluster leadership - with MEDDPICC on every joint opportunity and weekly pipeline inspection. Data over opinions. Process over heroics.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Alliance leadership at scale: 10+ years in strategic alliances, partner sales, business development, or ecosystem leadership in enterprise software or AI infrastructure, with a proven track record building a strategic technology alliance that produced significant, measurable partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue.

  • Deep NVIDIA ecosystem experience: You have managed an NVIDIA alliance, co-sold with NVIDIA field teams, or operated deeply within the NVIDIA Partner Network and GPU ecosystem - and you know how to navigate a massive, matrixed organization from senior technical decision-makers to GTM leadership.

  • AI infrastructure fluency: Working understanding of NVIDIA's technologies and programs (GPUs, DGX, SuperPOD, networking/DPUs, AI Enterprise, NCP, ISV certification) and of Kubernetes, cloud-native platforms, and AI/ML infrastructure - enough to earn credibility with architects and translate it into business value, ROI, and outcomes for executives.

  • Influence without authority: Demonstrated ability to mobilize cross-functional teams - Product, Engineering, Marketing, regional sales - on both sides of an alliance, without direct organizational control.

  • Operating rigor: Consultative, outcomes-based style with disciplined qualification (MEDDPICC or equivalent), forecasting hygiene, and reporting discipline.

  • Builder's instinct: Comfort operating in an ambiguous, high-velocity environment. You compress timelines rather than manage them - a builder, not a caretaker.

Bonus points for:

  • Existing NVIDIA relationships: A live network across NVIDIA partner programs, solutions architecture, or field sales that shortens your ramp.

  • Open-source ecosystem familiarity: Experience positioning open-source-born platforms inside large vendor ecosystems.

  • Multi-party deal construction: History of building OEM, storage, or GSI plays around an anchor silicon partner.

  • MBA or equivalent commercial depth: Useful for program structuring and executive business reviews.

About vCluster Labs

We are a venture-backed tech startup and the company pioneering Kubernetes virtualization for the AI era. We raised +$30M from top-tier VCs such as Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, Doordash) and are in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to complement our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe and we have a remote-first work culture.

We are the leading platform for operating GPU infrastructure, enabling AI Cloud providers to deliver a hyperscaler-like experience to their customers and AI factories that need to build that same experience for their internal teams. Our platform delivers the full operational stack operators need to run their GPU data centers — managed Kubernetes, fast isolated tenant provisioning, and automated node provisioning and lifecycle management — enabling them to accelerate time to value, reduce operational burden, and maximize the ROI of every GPU.

We're the company behind vCluster, an open-source technology for virtualizing Kubernetes (10k+ GitHub stars, 40M+ virtual clusters created since 2021). Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI — a Kubernetes-native framework purpose-built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Platinum-Level Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

Compensation Range: $225K - $280K
